must_identify.item: The container being killed is the log-shipper sidecar, not the api container
must_identify.evidence: the termination reason is OOMKilled exitCode=137 container=log-shipper pod=api-7d4b6f6f7d-xm4zr

must_identify.item: The sidecar is OOMKilled because its 16Mi limit is below its usage
must_identify.evidence: Container ran out of memory and was killed by Kubernetes.

notes: The RCA names the log-shipper container as OOMKilled but never says the api container is healthy. It also never mentions the 16Mi limit. The memory fix is generic ('Increase memory limits in deployment YAML') and does not name the container, so a reviewer should confirm it would be applied to the sidecar. The Deployment replica-sync and Service-readiness findings (incl. 'Ensure app starts correctly') are noise or misleading.
